title: Fresh-seed review (15) of c44's moat cut in the low-noise layered CIPS world: replicated; at t=15000 an absorbing fuel moat kills each of two targeted bodies within 25-50 t (218 -> 10 -> 0 px, 269 -> 0 px) while the fed twin keeps all 15 bodies and the untargeted one keeps its size
summary: Ran the low-noise world (20261026T1626-c44-cips-lownoise-gen4-claim/world.py, unchanged) on seed 15 with labkit (192^2, 150 frames, t=15000: 4 nucleations, 11 persistent splits, generation 2, 0 merges, 15 bodies) and with the finding's cutmany.py (seed 15, cut at t=15000, 1000 t after, FRAC 0.6, 2 targets, moat inner radius 16). The two targets are the two most isolated bodies (the named seed-0 track does not exist on a new seed). Fed twin: 15 bodies, target areas 218 -> 214 and 269 -> 275 px at t=15975. Arm cut0: target 218 -> 10 px at t=15025 and 0 at t=15050, the other target 259-263 px, 14 outside bodies kept. Arm cut1: target 269 -> 0 px at t=15025, the other target 216-228 px, 14 outside bodies kept. Fuel inside the moat disk falls from 0.74-0.79 to ~1e-5.

observations.E: cut_s15.json / cut_s15.png: targets dead at t=15050 (cut0) and t=15025 (cut1); fed twin keeps both (214, 275 px) and all 15 bodies; untargeted bodies unchanged in each arm

seeds_run.result: replicates: 2 of 2 moated bodies die within 25-50 t; fed twin and neighbours kept

controls_run.E: fed twin branched from the same t=15000 state (cut_s15.json 'fed')

verdicts.limitation: The targets are the two most isolated bodies at t=15000 on seed 15, not a named generation-4 track (the pack reaches generation 2 by t=15000 on this seed); one cut time and one moat geometry. The moat is an imposed absorbing fuel sink.
